title: BUZZING BEE
storyTitleEn: Bite, buzz, release: How bees make flowers give up their pollen
storyTitleJa: Bite, buzz, release: How bees make flowers give up their pollen
imageAltEn: The Daily Duck yellow duck mascot for Buzzing Bee
imageAltJa: Buzzing BeeをテーマにしたThe Daily Duckの黄色いダック
storyEn: Nature has some clever tricks, and bees have mastered a fascinating one for gathering pollen. By biting into flowers and using rapid muscle vibrations, they shake the pollen free in a method known as 'bite, buzz, release.' It is a wonderful example of tiny creatures using smart techniques to get their work done.
storyJa: 自然界には面白い工夫があふれていますが、ハチも花粉を集めるための見事な技を持っています。花にかみつき、素早い筋肉の振動を利用して花粉を振り落とす「かんで、震えて、放す」という手法です。小さな生き物が見せる賢い工夫の素晴らしい例といえます。
duckEn: Quack! Bite, buzz, release—bees sure know how to get things moving!
duckJa: クワッ！かんで、震えて、放す—ハチの振動テクニックはすごいね！
archiveSummaryEn: Ever wonder how bees shake pollen free from flowers? They use a clever technique: bite, buzz with rapid muscle vibrations, and release!
archiveSummaryJa: ハチはどうやって花から花粉を取り出している？花にかみついて素早く筋肉を震わせる巧みなテクニックを紹介！
